correction_scope: Corrects Vietnamese edition chapter-number alignment stated in Round 70 v7.0. The extraction facts and quantities from Chinese printed Chapters 1112–1121 are unchanged.
corrected_claim: The Round 70 v7.0 catalog/audit stated Cơm Nguội Vietnamese Ch1116 matched Chinese printed Ch1112 and inferred a +4 offset.
corrected_alignment: Cơm Nguội Vietnamese Ch1116 title 'Thần cấp Băng Sào xuất thế! Bão táp tai kiếp bùng nổ!' matches Chinese printed Ch1113 title '神级冰巢现世！灾劫狂潮爆发！'. In this arc Vietnamese numbering is +3, not +4.
independent_confirmation: Cơm Nguội Vietnamese Ch1127 title 'Bản vẽ Sáng Thế Chi Quang, vũ khí sắc bén đối phó Chân Thần!' matches Chinese printed Ch1124 '创世之光图纸，对付真神的利器！', confirming +3 at a second chapter anchor.

authority_note: For this novel arc, use +3 only where the Vietnamese title matches the Chinese printed title. Do not generalize the offset to other editions such as segmented Bách Ngọc Sách or differently numbered Xa Lộ Sách.
